notice: Stock-model benchmark tasks with deterministic graders. Answers are scripted replies to any question the agent asks (first option, or the text). Grading reads the final revision's design.json and geometry.json only.

tasks.prompt: Make a 60 x 40 x 8 mm mounting plate with four 5 mm through holes, each centred 8 mm from its two nearest edges.

answers.default: Use exactly those dimensions; no other features.

tasks.prompt: Make a round spacer: 20 mm outer diameter, 6.5 mm through hole, 12 mm tall.

Make a rectangular airflow duct 120 mm long, 55 mm wide, 35 mm tall, with 3 mm walls, open at both ends along its length, and four 3 mm through holes in the top wall in a 36 x 36 mm square pattern centred on the top face.

answers.default: As specified; the open ends are the two 55 x 35 faces.

tasks.prompt: Make a two-part project box: base 90 x 60 x 25 mm outside with 2 mm walls and floor, open top, plus a separate flat lid 90 x 60 x 3 mm placed beside it with at least a 5 mm gap for printing.

answers.default: No cutouts, no lip needed; just base and lid.

tasks.prompt: Make a 50 x 30 x 6 mm plate. Then, once it is saved, change its length to 70 mm using the existing parameter.

answers.default: Yes, change the existing length parameter to 70.

tasks.prompt: Make a decorative vase about 120 mm tall with a 40 mm base, widening to about 70 mm near the top and narrowing to a 50 mm mouth, hollow with 2 mm walls, open at the top.

answers.default: Any pleasing profile is fine; keep it printable.
